errorCodes.meaning: No board the caller may see has this identifier (VTI-BRD-003).
The board is open. Close it first (`vtc/boards/update`, `status: closed`), which ends its voting (VTI-BRD-006).

An idea's election has not closed or been cancelled — one that does not allow closing early, or one the ballot box has not yet answered closing for. Retry once it has; `vtc/boards/show` names the ideas.

BoardId.description: Opaque identifier of a board: `brd_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BRD-001).
BoardId.title: BoardId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/boards/delete/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/boards/delete/0.1#response.

electionsRemoved.description: Elections whose content the community removed. Each keeps a tombstone unless the retention is zero.

tombstones.description: What the community keeps of the board's elections (VTI-BRD-007, VTI-BRD-008).

kept.description: Tombstones kept: each an election's identifier, manifest digest and the board heads the community kept. Zero when the retention is zero.

removeAt.description: When they are removed. Absent when the retention is unbounded, or when none was kept.

schema.description: A board manager deletes a closed board: its ideas, notes and each election's content are removed, and each election keeps only a tombstone for the community's tombstone retention. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the deletion in the community's audit trail.
